visual_review: User-style bust at the lower left, a tall IV pole on a foot at the right whose arm carries a hanging drip bag, and a drip line curving from the bag to the patient's shoulder, as in the reference. The current drawing used a stick figure whose arm fused into a box-shaped pole, so the bag, line and patient did not read separately.
omissions: The pole's top hook and the reference's full-length body are simplified; the bag is the minimum 8x10.
